blocks.p: While the line is out, the rod in your hands is drawn above the belt, and it shows the tension on the line. Figure 40-1 shows the line slack.
As the line is drawn tighter, the pointer comes up, the rod bows and the wraps on the rod turn gold, then red.

marks.text: The dial on the reel is the tension meter. Slack, its pointer rests low on the left.
The line sags while it is slack.

sticky.text: The rod shows the tension on the line.

blocks.p: Figure 40-2 shows the same rod with the line tight, top, and at the limit, bottom. At the limit, *MAX* on the reel lights red, and past it the line snaps.

caption: Figure 40-2
Tight, top, and at the limit, bottom.

blocks.p: Each state shows on the dial, in the bend of the rod and in the color of the wraps. The line turns pale red only at the limit.

marks.text: Tight: the rod bows, the pointer comes up and the wraps start to turn gold.
At the limit MAX lights red, the wraps run to red and the line goes pale red. Past it, the line snaps.

sticky.text: Past the limit, the line snaps.
